next_step: Run Redwood Optimize perf bench + quantized model pass (SE-led)
notes:
Overview:
- Pegasus builds low-latency inference middleware for programmatic ad auctions and real-time personalization. Very latency- and cost-sensitive: target p95 end-to-end <80ms for model calls inside the bidding path, strict budget per 1M tokens.

Primary ask / hypothesis:
- Want Redwood to show end-to-end perf and unit-cost advantages vs their in-house Triton-based stack. Interested in Optimize recommendations: batching rules, KV prefix caching, and quantization profiles that preserve quality at 4-bit/INT8. Also care about model routing/fallbacks during load spikes.

Technical constraints:
- Runs in public cloud but operator insists on VPC peering with customer networking for telemetry. No full air-gapped requirement yet but legal asks for data residency in us-east-1 for ad data.
- Need SSO + role-based access (SAML). KMS for key wrapping of model artifacts.
- P95 latency budget includes network hop to Redwood infrastructure; want pre/post token timing breakdowns.

What we've done so far (timeline):
- 2025-11-05: inbound lead, discovery call (Daniel) — high-level needs captured.
- 2025-12-01: sent pricing deck and Redwood Dedicated one-pager (drive).
- 2026-01-14: technical deep-dive with engineering + product (Priya in), discussed batching/caching/quantization constraints.
- 2026-02-18: demo of hosted API, showed streaming + function-calling. (fireflies ff_2026-02-18_pegasus-demo)
- 2026-03-02: SE perf deep-dive; customer delivered benchmark harness and replay dataset (ff_2026-03-02_tech-deep-dive).
- 2026-03-10: Redwood delivered initial perf smoke numbers (internal): approx 95ms p95 with baseline 16-bit model on a single GPU; customer asked for quantized run and batching strategy.

Specific perf/benchmark asks from customer:
- Run 3 configurations against their replay harness: (1) hosted 16-bit baseline, (2) dedicated with continuous batching + prefix cache, (3) quantized model (4-bit or INT8) on dedicated hardware. Provide p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec throughput, and token cost.
- Show degradation curves for tail latency as concurrency increases. Need detailed traces and tracer IDs.
- Want to test automatic fallback policy: if dedicated pool load >80% route to cheaper compatible variant.

Quality tolerance and metrics:
- Model output quality must retain >=98% of current rerank NDCG@10 on benchmark. Will accept small hallucination shifts but will validate.

Commercial/Procurement notes:
- Procurement and legal pulled into discussions late Feb. Need SOC2 report and sample DPA. Want a trial commitment for 3 months with explicit SLA.
- Pricing sensitivity: willing to commit to a Dedicated monthly seat if Redwood improves unit cost by >=20% vs their infra.

Next steps (near term):
- SE to run the three requested perf configs by 2026-03-20 and share bench results + traces. (Priya)
- Security to send SOC2 + KMS integration guide; legal to align on DPA.
- Set up canary routing test for 1% traffic within their sandbox.

Open questions / blockers from customer:
- "Can you guarantee p95 <80ms for the quantized path at our expected concurrency?" — they want hard numbers, not estimates.
- Clarify how Redwood Optimize recommendations translate into config that can be applied automatically for live traffic.
- Legal: need a shorter SLA turnaround for incident response (30 min).

Notes style / misc:
- Several shorthand notes from calls included in attachments (drive).
- Customer often uses internal jargon: "bid-path slab" = the synchronous path that cannot block for >100ms.
- They emphasized: "We need predictable tail, not just average throughput."

Sales cues:
- Heavy internal engineering influence; technical POC will decide. Budget exists but needs exec signoff post-bench.
- Strong interest in Redwood Optimize as it directly affects cost target; if Optimize recommendations hit target, high likelihood to sign Dedicated commit.

Stated owner next actions:
- Daniel/Rveda: coordinate legal + procurement kickoff (Daniel).
- Priya: perf bench run and send artifacts (traces/gist) by 2026-03-20.

Recent quotes / direct lines:
- Customer engineering lead: "If you can show the 4-bit run at p95 under 80ms with our harness, procurement signs."
- AE note: prioritize quantized bench and fallback routing demo in next call.
